<section id="sec-trt-what" class="level2" data-number="4.1">
<h2 data-number="4.1" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-trt-what"><span class="header-section-number">4.1</span> TensorRT là gì — và không phải gì?</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>TensorRT chỉ là “tool convert ONNX”, hay là compiler thật sự?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>TensorRT</strong> = model optimizer + GPU kernel/tactic selector + precision optimizer + runtime executor trên <strong>NVIDIA GPU</strong>. Nó <strong>compile</strong> graph thành engine chuyên biệt cho hardware và shape — không chỉ đọc ONNX rồi execute từng op như interpreter đơn giản.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Pipeline deployment điển hình: train → export ONNX → build TensorRT engine → serve production.</p>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="6.5" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">

</div>
</div>

</tr>

<td style="text-align: left;">Triton = serving (HTTP/gRPC, batching, repo, metrics); TRT = engine Triton có thể serve</td>

</tr>

</tr>

<p>Cách 1–2 dùng TensorRT trực tiếp. Cách 3 dùng qua ORT.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">

</div>
<div id="callout-5" class="callout-5-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Train trong PyTorch / TensorFlow<br>
</li>
<li>Export ONNX<br>
</li>
<li>Validate ONNX bằng ORT<br>
</li>
<li>Simplify / fix ONNX nếu cần<br>
</li>
<li>Parse ONNX bằng TensorRT<br>
</li>
<li>Chọn precision (FP32 / TF32 / FP16 / INT8 / …)<br>
</li>
<li>Chọn shapes hoặc optimization profiles<br>
</li>
<li>Build engine<br>
</li>
<li>Serialize plan file<br>
</li>
<li>Load engine trong runtime<br>
</li>
<li>Allocate input/output buffers<br>
</li>
<li>Set input shape nếu dynamic<br>
</li>
<li>Enqueue lên CUDA stream<br>
</li>
<li>Copy output hoặc giữ trên GPU</li>
</ol>
<p>Trong production thường build trước: <code>model.onnx → model_fp16.plan</code>, rồi deserialize lúc startup — không build lại mỗi request. Build lớn + nhiều profile có thể mất <strong>vài phút đến hàng chục phút</strong>; deserialize thường <strong>giây</strong>.</p>
</div>

<section id="sec-objects" class="level2" data-number="4.2">
<h2 data-number="4.2" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-objects"><span class="header-section-number">4.2</span> Objects cốt lõi trong TensorRT</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Builder, Engine, ExecutionContext — cái nào “compile”, cái nào “chạy”?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Nhớ chuỗi: <strong>Builder</strong> (+ NetworkDefinition + BuilderConfig) tạo <strong>engine</strong> (compiled model) → <strong>Runtime</strong> deserialize plan → <strong>ExecutionContext</strong> giữ state runtime và <strong>enqueue</strong> lên CUDA stream. Một engine có thể tạo nhiều context (concurrent streams/workers).</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 23%">
<col style="width: 41%">
<col style="width: 35%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Object</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Mental model</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Việc chính</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>Builder</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Compiler driver</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Nhận network + config (precision, workspace, profiles, timing cache) → serialized engine</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>NetworkDefinition</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Graph nội bộ TRT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Từ ONNX Parser hoặc tự <code>network.add_convolution_nd(...)</code> / <code>mark_output</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>BuilderConfig</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Compiler flags</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Precision, memory pool/workspace, profiles, timing cache, profiling, compatibility, DLA…</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>ICudaEngine</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Compiled model</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Biết I/O, profiles, tactics, memory needs, layer plan, precision/layout; serialize <code>.plan</code>/<code>.engine</code>/<code>.trt</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>Runtime</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Loader</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>plan file → ICudaEngine</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>ExecutionContext</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Per-execution state</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Profile đang chọn, runtime shape, tensor addresses, activation memory state</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">CUDA stream</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Async queue</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU enqueue → GPU chạy; đo latency phải synchronize đúng</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Con đường phổ biến từ PyTorch: <code>PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT ONNX Parser → NetworkDefinition</code>.</p>
<p>Tên đuôi file (<code>.plan</code> / <code>.engine</code> / <code>.trt</code>) không bắt buộc — quan trọng là nội dung serialized engine.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-7-contents" aria-controls="callout-7" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Đào sâu: ExecutionContext và stream
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-7" class="callout-7-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Execution thường <strong>asynchronous</strong>. Sai: đo wall-clock mà không sync stream → số ảo. Đúng: enqueue rồi <code>cudaStreamSynchronize</code> (hoặc CUDA event) khi cần latency E2E. Context giữ state dynamic shape — đổi shape liên tục có overhead cập nhật nội bộ (xem <a href="#sec-profiles" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.6</span></a>).</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-build-runtime" class="level2" data-number="4.3">
<h2 data-number="4.3" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-build-runtime"><span class="header-section-number">4.3</span> Build phase vs runtime phase</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Vì sao build engine chậm nhưng inference phải nhanh — và sai ở đâu nếu gộp hai pha?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Build</strong> = compiler (parse, fuse, chọn tactic, plan memory, serialize) — có thể chậm. <strong>Runtime</strong> = load engine + context + buffers + enqueue — phải phục vụ request nhanh. Production: <strong>không</strong> build trong request path.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="7" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l4-build-runtime" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">
<figure class="quarto-float quarto-float-fig figure">
<div aria-describedby="fig-l4-build-runtime-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
<div>
<pre class="mermaid mermaid-js" data-label="fig-l4-build-runtime">flowchart LR
  O([ONNX]) --&gt; N([Network])
  N --&gt; B([Builder])
