  class N,B,E hot
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<figcaption class="quarto-float-caption-bottom quarto-float-caption quarto-float-fig" id="fig-l4-build-runtime-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
Hình&nbsp;4.3: Build phase (tô sáng) vs runtime: ONNX → Builder → plan; rồi Runtime → Context → GPU.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 33%">
<col style="width: 66%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Pha</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Việc làm</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Build</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Parse ONNX, validate, infer shapes, fold constants, fuse, chọn format/precision, benchmark tactics, memory plan, serialize</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Runtime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Deserialize, tạo context, allocate buffers, set shape, set addresses, enqueue, sync/copy khi cần</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Sai:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>request → parse ONNX → build engine → run inference → response</code></pre>
<p>Đúng:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>service startup → load engine
request → enqueue inference → response</code></pre>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-warning no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Cảnh báo</span>Bẫy thường gặp
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Cùng một ONNX, build trên GPU khác hoặc TensorRT version khác có thể ra engine/tactic khác. Coi <code>.plan</code> là artifact <strong>gắn hardware + version</strong>, không phải “ONNX thứ hai” portable tuyệt đối (xem <a href="#sec-debug-prod" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.12</span></a>).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-10-contents" aria-controls="callout-10" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Pseudo-flow hai pha
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-10" class="callout-10-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Build: <code>ONNX → parse → NetworkDefinition → optimize → choose kernels/tactics → memory plan → serialized engine</code>.<br>
Runtime: <code>serialized engine → deserialize → execution context → set shapes/buffers → enqueue → outputs</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-build" class="level2" data-number="4.4">
<h2 data-number="4.4" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-build"><span class="header-section-number">4.4</span> Build pipeline: TensorRT compile như thế nào?</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Từ <code>.onnx</code> đến <code>.plan</code>, từng bước compiler ảnh hưởng latency thế nào?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Build = chuỗi: <strong>parse → shape analysis → constant folding / DCE → layer fusion → layout → precision → tactic selection → memory planning → serialize</strong>. Nhiều ONNX nodes có thể thành ít engine layers. Unsupported op làm parse/build fail — ORT chạy được không đảm bảo TRT build được.</p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="parse-onnx" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="parse-onnx">Parse ONNX</h3>
<p>Parser đọc <code>.onnx</code> → <code>NetworkDefinition</code> (nodes → layers, tensors, weights).</p>
<p>Lỗi thường gặp trong log:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>Unsupported operator: GridSample
Unsupported ONNX data type
No importer registered for op: SomeCustomOp</code></pre>
<p>Thứ tự xử lý: (1) opset phù hợp, (2) <code>onnxsim</code>, (3) rewrite model, (4) ONNX GraphSurgeon, (5) TensorRT plugin, (6) chạy op ngoài TRT.</p>
</section>
<section id="shape-analysis" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="shape-analysis">Shape analysis</h3>
<p>Static <code>[1,3,224,224]</code> → tối ưu hẹp cho shape đó. Dynamic <code>[-1,3,-1,-1]</code> → cần optimization profile (<code>min</code>/<code>opt</code>/<code>max</code>) — xem <a href="#sec-profiles" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.6</span></a>.</p>
</section>
<section id="constant-folding-và-dce" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="constant-folding-và-dce">Constant folding và DCE</h3>
<p>Constant chỉ phụ thuộc constant → tính trước lúc build. Nhánh không ảnh hưởng output → loại bỏ (dead computation elimination).</p>
</section>
<section id="layer-fusion" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="layer-fusion">Layer fusion</h3>
<p>Ví dụ <code>Conv → BatchNorm → ReLU</code> có thể thành fused Conv+Scale+ReLU: ít kernel launch, ít read/write intermediate, giảm bandwidth, tăng locality, dùng kernel chuyên biệt.</p>
<pre class="text"><code>Không phải càng nhiều ONNX nodes thì runtime càng nhiều GPU kernels.</code></pre>
</section>
<section id="layout-data-format" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="layout-data-format">Layout / data format</h3>
<p>ONNX có thể NCHW; TRT có thể chọn format nội bộ vectorized/channel-packed. Quan tâm boundary input/output, plugin format, và <strong>reformat layers</strong> (đổi layout nhiều lần → chậm).</p>
</section>
<section id="precision-tactic-memory-serialize" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="precision-tactic-memory-serialize">Precision, tactic, memory, serialize</h3>
<p>Precision (FP32/TF32/FP16/INT8…) theo config + hardware — chi tiết <a href="#sec-fp16" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.7</span></a> và <a href="#sec-int8" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.8</span></a>. Tactic selection — <a href="#sec-tactics" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.5</span></a>. Memory planning reuse activation buffers → peak VRAM, max batch, nhiều context. Serialize: <code>ICudaEngine → model.plan</code>.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-12-contents" aria-controls="callout-12" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Đào sâu: fusion, reformat và dump
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-12" class="callout-12-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Nếu <code>--dumpLayerInfo</code> / <code>--dumpProfile</code> thấy nhiều <strong>reformat</strong>, bottleneck có thể là layout chứ không phải Conv. Một engine layer có thể tương ứng nhiều ONNX nodes sau fusion. Nếu một layer chiếm ~60% latency, tối ưu “toàn graph” kém hiệu quả hơn hiểu đúng layer đó (Lab 4).</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="sec-tactics" class="level2" data-number="4.5">
<h2 data-number="4.5" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-tactics"><span class="header-section-number">4.5</span> Tactic selection, workspace và timing cache</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Vì sao build lâu — và workspace nhỏ có thể làm engine chậm hơn?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>Tactic</strong> = implementation/kernel strategy cụ thể cho layer (hoặc fused layer). Builder liệt kê candidate, lọc (unsupported / vượt workspace), benchmark hoặc ước lượng, chọn winner. Workspace quá nhỏ → loại tactic nhanh cần nhiều temp memory. <strong>Timing cache</strong> tái dùng kết quả timing để rebuild/CI nhanh hơn. Sau đổi precision/rebuild: luôn validate accuracy.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Một Conv/MatMul có thể có nhiều tactic (implicit GEMM, Winograd, FFT-like, Tensor Core tiling/layout khác nhau…).</p>
<p>Tactic phụ thuộc: GPU architecture, input shape, batch, precision, tensor layout, workspace limit, libraries/kernels, optimization profile, builder optimization level, timing cache, môi trường.</p>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="6" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l4-tactic" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">
<figure class="quarto-float quarto-float-fig figure">
<div aria-describedby="fig-l4-tactic-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
<div>
<pre class="mermaid mermaid-js" data-label="fig-l4-tactic">flowchart TB
  L([Layer / fused]) --&gt; C([Candidate tactics])
  C --&gt;|"filter"| F([Workspace OK?])
  F --&gt;|"time / estimate"| W([Winner tactic])
  W --&gt; E([Engine plan])
  classDef soft fill:#F7FAFC,stroke:#7B8A9A,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#243447
  classDef hot fill:#FFF8E1,stroke:#F9A825,stroke-width:2px,color:#5C3B10
  classDef ok fill:#EAF3FF,stroke:#4A90E2,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#1F3A5F
  class L,C soft
  class F,W hot
  class E ok
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<figcaption class="quarto-float-caption-bottom quarto-float-caption quarto-float-fig" id="fig-l4-tactic-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
Hình&nbsp;4.4: Tactic selection: candidate → lọc workspace → timing/estimate → winner vào engine.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>Mental model (đủ để debug):</p>
<pre class="text"><code>for each layer or fused subgraph:
    list candidate tactics
    filter unsupported tactics
    filter tactics exceeding workspace limit
    benchmark / estimate candidate tactics
    choose best tactic</code></pre>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 47%">
<col style="width: 52%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Cơ chế</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Vai trò</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Workspace / memory pool</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cho phép (hoặc loại) tactic cần buffer tạm lớn</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Timing cache</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">First build: time nhiều tactic → lưu; lần sau reuse → nhanh hơn</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Accuracy</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Chủ yếu perf; FP16 overflow, INT8 quant error vẫn cần metric</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Timing cache hữu ích khi: build nhiều model tương tự, rebuild thường xuyên, CI nhiều variants/profiles/precision.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-warning no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Cảnh báo</span>Bẫy thường gặp
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Đặt workspace “cực thấp cho chắc” có thể ép builder chọn tactic chậm hơn (<code>workspace too small → fast tactic unavailable</code>). Cùng Conv: <code>batch=1, 224²</code> vs <code>batch=32</code> vs sequence dài → winner khác — đó là lý do <code>opt</code> shape và GPU target quyết định mạnh.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-15-contents" aria-controls="callout-15" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Đào sâu: tactic và numeric behavior
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-15" class="callout-15-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Tactic selection chủ yếu performance, nhưng precision thấp thì choice có thể ảnh hưởng số học: FP16 overflow/underflow intermediate; INT8 quantization/clamping; reduction/normalization nhạy precision. Production rule: sau đổi precision hoặc rebuild engine, luôn validate accuracy metric — không chỉ nhìn latency.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-profiles" class="level2" data-number="4.6">
<h2 data-number="4.6" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-profiles"><span class="header-section-number">4.6</span> Dynamic shapes và optimization profiles</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Dynamic axes trong ONNX đã đủ — hay TensorRT còn cần <code>min</code>/<code>opt</code>/<code>max</code>?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>ONNX có thể khai báo <code>-1</code> (dynamic). TensorRT <strong>không tối ưu miền vô hạn</strong>: mỗi dynamic input cần <strong>optimization profile</strong> với <code>min</code>, <code>opt</code>, <code>max</code>. Builder ưu tiên tối ưu quanh <strong><code>opt</code></strong>, nhưng tactic phải hợp lệ trên cả <code>[min, max]</code>. Profile quá rộng → tactic “an toàn” → chậm ở traffic thật. Nhiều profile hẹp thường tốt hơn một profile khổng lồ. Runtime shape ngoài range → fail.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Ví dụ:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>input name: images
min: [1, 3, 224, 224]
opt: [8, 3, 224, 224]
max: [32, 3, 224, 224]</code></pre>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Trường</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>min</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape nhỏ nhất engine cho phép</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>opt</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape builder ưu tiên tối ưu performance</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>max</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape lớn nhất engine cho phép</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Runtime: <code>min ≤ runtime_shape ≤ max</code>.</p>
<div class="cell" data-fig-width="5.5" data-layout-align="center">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div id="fig-l4-profile" class="quarto-float quarto-figure quarto-figure-center anchored">
<figure class="quarto-float quarto-float-fig figure">
<div aria-describedby="fig-l4-profile-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
<div>
<pre class="mermaid mermaid-js" data-label="fig-l4-profile">flowchart LR
  Min([min]) --&gt;|"range"| Max([max])
  Opt([opt]) -.-&gt;|"ưu tiên tactic"| Min
  Opt -.-&gt; Max
  classDef soft fill:#F7FAFC,stroke:#7B8A9A,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#243447
  classDef hot fill:#FFE082,stroke:#F57F17,stroke-width:2px,color:#5C3B10
  class Min,Max soft
  class Opt hot
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<figcaption class="quarto-float-caption-bottom quarto-float-caption quarto-float-fig" id="fig-l4-profile-caption-0ceaefa1-69ba-4598-a22c-09a6ac19f8ca">
Hình&nbsp;4.5: Optimization profile: range hợp lệ [min, max]; builder tối ưu mạnh quanh opt.
</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>Batch cũng là shape dimension (explicit batch). Muốn batch động → profile cho <code>N</code> trong <code>[N,3,224,224]</code>.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 63%">
<col style="width: 36%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Tình huống</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Gợi ý</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Traffic chủ yếu batch 1</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>opt</code> gần batch 1; đừng <code>opt=32</code> chỉ vì <code>max=32</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Real-time batch 1–4 + job 16–64</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Hai profiles, không một range 1–64</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Ảnh 224 và 512</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Profiles tách theo độ phân giải</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Đổi shape liên tục trong một context</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Overhead cập nhật state — thiết kế batching/routing</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Runtime flow:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>1. Deserialize engine
2. Create execution context
3. Select optimization profile
4. Set input shape
5. Set tensor addresses
6. Enqueue inference</code></pre>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb10-1"><a href="#cb10-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_optimization_profile_async(profile_index, stream_handle)</span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a href="#cb10-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_input_shape(<span class="st">"images"</span>, (<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>))</span>
<span id="cb10-3"><a href="#cb10-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_tensor_address(<span class="st">"images"</span>, input_device_ptr)</span>
<span id="cb10-4"><a href="#cb10-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_tensor_address(<span class="st">"logits"</span>, output_device_ptr)</span>
<span id="cb10-5"><a href="#cb10-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.execute_async_v3(stream_handle<span class="op">=</span>stream_handle)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>(Tên hàm có thể khác nhẹ theo version TensorRT; flow tư duy giữ nguyên.)</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-17-contents" aria-controls="callout-17" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Case: profile quá rộng làm batch 1 chậm
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-17" class="callout-17-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Profile “linh hoạt”: <code>min=[1,3,128,128]</code>, <code>opt=[16,3,1024,1024]</code>, <code>max=[64,3,4096,4096]</code> trong khi production chủ yếu <code>[1,3,224,224]</code> → latency batch 1 kém vì tối ưu quanh <code>opt</code> xa traffic và range quá rộng. Sửa: Profile 0 realtime <code>min=opt=max</code> quanh 224 batch 1–4; Profile 1 high-res riêng nếu cần. Rule: <strong>profile phản ánh traffic thật</strong> — không tạo profile siêu rộng “cho chắc”.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-fp16" class="level2" data-number="4.7">
<h2 data-number="4.7" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-fp16"><span class="header-section-number">4.7</span> FP32, TF32 và FP16 trong TensorRT</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Bật <code>--fp16</code> có nghĩa mọi layer chạy FP16 không — và khi nào dễ mất accuracy?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong>FP16</strong> thường là bước tối ưu đầu tiên trên Tensor Cores (giảm bandwidth/footprint, tăng throughput). <code>--fp16</code> = <strong>cho phép</strong> FP16 tactics — không nhất thiết ép toàn graph FP16; một số layer có thể giữ FP32. Sau FP16: so TensorRT FP32 vs FP16 và vs ORT; kiểm NaN/Inf.</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 35%">
<col style="width: 32%">
<col style="width: 32%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Precision</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Đặc điểm</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Khi dùng</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">FP32</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Baseline accuracy; tốn bandwidth hơn</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Reference khi validate</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">TF32</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Ampere+; range gần FP32, mantissa thấp hơn; thường mặc định một số matmul</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cần reproducibility chặt → kiểm config</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">FP16</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">16-bit float; Tensor Cores; range nhỏ hơn → overflow/underflow</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Optimization đầu tiên nên thử</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">INT8</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cần scale/calibration/QDQ — <a href="#sec-int8" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.8</span></a></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Throughput/memory tight</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Bật FP16 bằng <code>trtexec</code>:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb11-1"><a href="#cb11-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a href="#cb11-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a href="#cb11-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a href="#cb11-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:8x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a href="#cb11-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--fp16</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Flag</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>--onnx</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Input ONNX</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>--saveEngine</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Output serialized engine</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>--shapes</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape build/benchmark</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>--fp16</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cho phép FP16 tactics</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>FP16 dễ lỗi accuracy khi: activation magnitude lớn; reduction trên chiều lớn; normalization nhạy; softmax/log/exp range rộng; model chưa từng kiểm mixed precision; metric rất nhạy sai số nhỏ.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-19-contents" aria-controls="callout-19" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Checklist debug FP16 (NaN/Inf hoặc accuracy ↓)
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-19" class="callout-19-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Compare TensorRT FP32 vs TensorRT FP16<br>
</li>
<li>Compare TensorRT FP16 vs ONNX Runtime FP32<br>
</li>
<li>Check NaN/Inf<br>
</li>
<li>Dump intermediate bằng Polygraphy nếu cần<br>
</li>
<li>Force layer nhạy về FP32 nếu API/workflow cho phép<br>
</li>
<li>Kiểm preprocessing / input range<br>
</li>
<li>Validate preprocessing; scale/clip input nếu hợp lý; fine-tune mixed precision nếu cần</li>
</ol>
<p>Khi validate, thường so: PyTorch FP32 · ORT FP32 · TensorRT FP32/FP16/INT8.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-int8" class="level2" data-number="4.8">
<h2 data-number="4.8" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-int8"><span class="header-section-number">4.8</span> INT8 execution: calibration, PTQ, QAT và Q/DQ</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Vì sao INT8 không chỉ thêm <code>--int8</code> — và Q/DQ khác calibration implicit thế nào?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>INT8 map float → int8 qua <strong>scale</strong> (round + clamp). Accuracy loss đến từ <strong>rounding error</strong> và <strong>clamping error</strong>. Cần <strong>PTQ + calibration data đại diện</strong>, hoặc <strong>QAT</strong>, hoặc graph <strong>explicit Q/DQ</strong>. Hướng hiện đại ưu tiên explicit Q/DQ + strongly typed. Calibration data phải đúng preprocessing và shape/profile traffic thật.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Mental model symmetric INT8:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>float_value → divide by scale → round → clamp to int8 range
int8_value → multiply by scale → approximate float_value</code></pre>
<p>Ví dụ đúng range:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>x_float = 0.73
scale = 0.01
x_int8 = round(0.73 / 0.01) = 73
x_dequant = 73 * 0.01 = 0.73</code></pre>
<p>Clamping error khi vượt range:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>x_float = 2.0
scale = 0.01
x_int8 = round(200) → clamp to 127
x_dequant = 1.27</code></pre>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Scale</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Hệ quả</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Quá nhỏ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Ít rounding cho value nhỏ; dễ clamp value lớn</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Quá lớn</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Ít clamp value lớn; rounding thô hơn cho value nhỏ</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Calibration / QAT tìm scale khớp distribution thật.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 41%">
<col style="width: 19%">
<col style="width: 38%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Phương pháp</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Flow</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ưu / nhược</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">PTQ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">FP32 → calibration set → ước range/scale → INT8</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Nhanh, không retrain; accuracy có thể giảm nếu data kém</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">QAT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Train với fake-quant → export QDQ ONNX → TRT INT8</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thường giữ accuracy tốt hơn; cần data + pipeline train</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Explicit Q/DQ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>QuantizeLinear</code>/<code>DequantizeLinear</code> trong graph</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Semantics rõ, dễ debug, TRT ít “đoán”</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Implicit calibration</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Bật INT8 + calibrator trong builder</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Còn hỗ trợ; hiện đại ưu tiên explicit khi được</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>INT8 + dynamic shapes: calibration cần calibration optimization profile — thường dùng <strong><code>opt</code></strong> của profile. Shape calibration phải khớp; calibration chỉ batch/shape không đại diện → accuracy kém ở runtime shapes khác.</p>
<p>Workflow Q/DQ thực tế:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>FP32 ONNX
  → quantization tool inserts Q/DQ nodes
  → quantized ONNX
  → TensorRT strongly typed build
  → INT8 engine</code></pre>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb16"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb16-1"><a href="#cb16-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">python3</span> <span class="at">-m</span> modelopt.onnx.quantization <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-2"><a href="#cb16-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--onnx_path</span> model.onnx <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-3"><a href="#cb16-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--quantize_mode</span> int8 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-4"><a href="#cb16-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--output_path</span> model_int8_qdq.onnx</span>
<span id="cb16-5"><a href="#cb16-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb16-6"><a href="#cb16-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-7"><a href="#cb16-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model_int8_qdq.onnx <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-8"><a href="#cb16-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:8x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-9"><a href="#cb16-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--stronglyTyped</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb16-10"><a href="#cb16-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_int8.plan</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p><code>--stronglyTyped</code>: tôn trọng data types trong graph. Q/DQ nói rõ chỗ quantize/dequantize và scale.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-warning no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Cảnh báo</span>Bẫy thường gặp
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Calibration bằng <strong>random data</strong> chỉ demo performance — <strong>không</strong> đủ đánh giá accuracy production. Preprocessing calibration khác production (thiếu normalize…) → scale sai → INT8 nhanh nhưng metric giảm mạnh. Chi tiết quantization sâu hơn ở Lesson 5.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-22-contents" aria-controls="callout-22" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Case: INT8 nhanh +50% nhưng accuracy giảm mạnh
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-22" class="callout-22-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Nguyên nhân thường: calibration vài ảnh random hoặc preprocessing khác production (<code>resize→crop→normalize</code> vs <code>resize</code> không normalize). Cách sửa: calibration set đại diện; đúng preprocessing; per-layer divergence; exclude sensitive layers; QAT nếu PTQ không đủ; đánh giá <strong>task metric</strong>, không chỉ tensor diff.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-trtexec" class="level2" data-number="4.9">
<h2 data-number="4.9" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-trtexec"><span class="header-section-number">4.9</span> <code>trtexec</code> và đọc benchmark</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p><code>trtexec</code> nhanh nghĩa là service chắc nhanh — và các dòng summary nghĩa là gì?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p><strong><code>trtexec</code></strong> là tool học/build/benchmark đầu tiên: tách vấn đề model/build khỏi bug app. Nếu <code>trtexec</code> fail → thường model/op/shape/config. Nếu <code>trtexec</code> nhanh mà app chậm → copy, alloc, sync, preprocess, batching. Đọc <strong>GPU Compute Time</strong>, H2D/D2H, enqueue, throughput; median ≠ p99.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p><code>trtexec</code> làm được: parse ONNX, build/save/load engine, benchmark latency/throughput, dump layer info / per-layer profile, kiểm shape/precision flags.</p>
<p>Output mẫu:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>=== Performance summary ===
Throughput: 507.399 qps
Latency: min = 1.963 ms, max = 1.975 ms, mean = 1.969 ms, median = 1.969 ms, percentile(99%) = 1.974 ms
Enqueue Time: mean = 0.004 ms
H2D Latency: mean = 0.000 ms
GPU Compute Time: mean = 1.969 ms
D2H Latency: mean = 0.000 ms</code></pre>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 44%">
<col style="width: 55%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Metric</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Cách đọc</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Throughput</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Inferences/s; batch=8 → phân biệt batch/s vs item/s (<code>100 batch/s × 8 = 800 images/s</code>)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Latency</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">E2E theo config <code>trtexec</code>; production quan tâm p95/p99</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU Compute Time</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Kernels thuần; Latency ≫ compute → copy/CPU/sync/alloc/queue/pre-post</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Enqueue Time</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU submit; cao → CPU-bound / launch-bound; CUDA Graphs có thể giúp</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">H2D / D2H</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Host↔︎Device; compute nhanh nhưng copy lớn → bottleneck không ở model</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>--noDataTransfers</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Đo compute sạch; E2E production vẫn có thể có transfer</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Benchmark ổn định hơn (Lab 1): <code>--useCudaGraph</code> (giảm enqueue overhead một số workload), <code>--useSpinWait</code> (timing ổn hơn, tốn CPU), <code>--duration=60</code>.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-24-contents" aria-controls="callout-24" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Đào sâu: khi app chậm hơn trtexec
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-24" class="callout-24-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Nguyên nhân app thường gặp: alloc mỗi request; copy CPU↔︎GPU thừa; preprocess/postprocess CPU; sync quá nhiều; không pinned memory; batch kém; tạo context mỗi request; Python/GIL; logging; queue server. Debug: đo riêng preprocess / H2D / enqueue+compute / D2H / postprocess; CUDA events; Nsight Systems; so <code>trtexec --noDataTransfers</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-python-api" class="level2" data-number="4.10">
<h2 data-number="4.10" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-python-api"><span class="header-section-number">4.10</span> Python API: build, runtime và memory</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Ngoài <code>trtexec</code>, build/run bằng Python cần quản lý gì về shape, addresses và buffers?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Python API (TensorRT 10.x style dưới đây — kiểm tra docs version của bạn): parse ONNX → BuilderConfig (workspace, FP16, profile) → <code>build_serialized_network</code>. Runtime: deserialize → context → <strong>tự</strong> quản lý device pointers + stream — TensorRT không tự map NumPy. Production: allocate/reuse buffers và context; tránh deserialize/alloc/free mỗi request; tránh D2H nếu postprocess vẫn trên GPU.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p>Build FP16 + dynamic profile (<code>build_engine.py</code>):</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb18"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb18-1"><a href="#cb18-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> sys</span>
<span id="cb18-2"><a href="#cb18-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> pathlib <span class="im">import</span> Path</span>
<span id="cb18-3"><a href="#cb18-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> tensorrt <span class="im">as</span> trt</span>
<span id="cb18-4"><a href="#cb18-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-5"><a href="#cb18-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-6"><a href="#cb18-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> build_engine(</span>
<span id="cb18-7"><a href="#cb18-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    onnx_path: <span class="bu">str</span>,</span>
<span id="cb18-8"><a href="#cb18-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    engine_path: <span class="bu">str</span>,</span>
<span id="cb18-9"><a href="#cb18-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    input_name: <span class="bu">str</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="st">"images"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb18-10"><a href="#cb18-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    min_shape<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>),</span>
<span id="cb18-11"><a href="#cb18-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    opt_shape<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>),</span>
<span id="cb18-12"><a href="#cb18-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    max_shape<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">32</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>),</span>
<span id="cb18-13"><a href="#cb18-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    fp16: <span class="bu">bool</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb18-14"><a href="#cb18-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    workspace_gib: <span class="bu">int</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">4</span>,</span>
<span id="cb18-15"><a href="#cb18-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>):</span>
<span id="cb18-16"><a href="#cb18-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    logger <span class="op">=</span> trt.Logger(trt.Logger.INFO)</span>
<span id="cb18-17"><a href="#cb18-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    builder <span class="op">=</span> trt.Builder(logger)</span>
<span id="cb18-18"><a href="#cb18-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="co"># TensorRT 10.x: explicit batch là mô hình bình thường</span></span>
<span id="cb18-19"><a href="#cb18-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    network <span class="op">=</span> builder.create_network(<span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-20"><a href="#cb18-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    parser <span class="op">=</span> trt.OnnxParser(network, logger)</span>
<span id="cb18-21"><a href="#cb18-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-22"><a href="#cb18-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> <span class="kw">not</span> parser.parse(Path(onnx_path).read_bytes()):</span>
<span id="cb18-23"><a href="#cb18-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">for</span> i <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">range</span>(parser.num_errors):</span>
<span id="cb18-24"><a href="#cb18-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="bu">print</span>(parser.get_error(i))</span>
<span id="cb18-25"><a href="#cb18-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">RuntimeError</span>(<span class="st">"ONNX parsing failed"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-26"><a href="#cb18-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-27"><a href="#cb18-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    config <span class="op">=</span> builder.create_builder_config()</span>
<span id="cb18-28"><a href="#cb18-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    config.set_memory_pool_limit(</span>
<span id="cb18-29"><a href="#cb18-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        trt.MemoryPoolType.WORKSPACE, workspace_gib <span class="op">*</span> (<span class="dv">1</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="dv">30</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-30"><a href="#cb18-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb18-31"><a href="#cb18-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> fp16:</span>
<span id="cb18-32"><a href="#cb18-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">if</span> builder.platform_has_fast_fp16:</span>
<span id="cb18-33"><a href="#cb18-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            config.set_flag(trt.BuilderFlag.FP16)</span>
<span id="cb18-34"><a href="#cb18-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">else</span>:</span>
<span id="cb18-35"><a href="#cb18-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Warning: platform may not have fast native FP16"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-36"><a href="#cb18-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-37"><a href="#cb18-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    profile <span class="op">=</span> builder.create_optimization_profile()</span>
<span id="cb18-38"><a href="#cb18-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    profile.set_shape(input_name, min_shape, opt_shape, max_shape)</span>
<span id="cb18-39"><a href="#cb18-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    config.add_optimization_profile(profile)</span>
<span id="cb18-40"><a href="#cb18-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-41"><a href="#cb18-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    serialized <span class="op">=</span> builder.build_serialized_network(network, config)</span>
<span id="cb18-42"><a href="#cb18-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> serialized <span class="kw">is</span> <span class="va">None</span>:</span>
<span id="cb18-43"><a href="#cb18-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">RuntimeError</span>(<span class="st">"Engine build failed"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-44"><a href="#cb18-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    Path(engine_path).write_bytes(<span class="bu">bytes</span>(serialized))</span>
<span id="cb18-45"><a href="#cb18-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"Saved TensorRT engine to: </span><span class="sc">{</span>engine_path<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-46"><a href="#cb18-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-47"><a href="#cb18-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-48"><a href="#cb18-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="va">__name__</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="st">"__main__"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb18-49"><a href="#cb18-49" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">len</span>(sys.argv) <span class="op">&lt;</span> <span class="dv">3</span>:</span>
<span id="cb18-50"><a href="#cb18-50" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Usage: python build_engine.py model.onnx model.plan"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-51"><a href="#cb18-51" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">SystemExit</span>(<span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-52"><a href="#cb18-52" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    build_engine(sys.argv[<span class="dv">1</span>], sys.argv[<span class="dv">2</span>])</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb19"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb19-1"><a href="#cb19-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">python</span> build_engine.py model.onnx model_fp16.plan</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Parse fail — nguyên nhân thường: unsupported op, dynamic shape chưa rõ, dtype không hỗ trợ, opset, custom op, export sai tên I/O.</p>
<p>Runtime flow:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>1. Read serialized engine bytes
2. Deserialize engine
3. Create execution context
4. Allocate device buffers
5. Copy input to GPU
6. Set runtime shape if dynamic
7. Bind tensor addresses
8. Execute asynchronously on CUDA stream
9. Copy output back or pass GPU pointer downstream
10. Synchronize only when needed</code></pre>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb21"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb21-1"><a href="#cb21-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> tensorrt <span class="im">as</span> trt</span>
<span id="cb21-2"><a href="#cb21-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-3"><a href="#cb21-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>logger <span class="op">=</span> trt.Logger(trt.Logger.INFO)</span>
<span id="cb21-4"><a href="#cb21-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>runtime <span class="op">=</span> trt.Runtime(logger)</span>
<span id="cb21-5"><a href="#cb21-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">with</span> <span class="bu">open</span>(<span class="st">"model_fp16.plan"</span>, <span class="st">"rb"</span>) <span class="im">as</span> f:</span>
<span id="cb21-6"><a href="#cb21-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    engine <span class="op">=</span> runtime.deserialize_cuda_engine(f.read())</span>
<span id="cb21-7"><a href="#cb21-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context <span class="op">=</span> engine.create_execution_context()</span>
<span id="cb21-8"><a href="#cb21-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-9"><a href="#cb21-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Allocate GPU buffers: cuda-python / PyCUDA / CuPy / PyTorch tensors</span></span>
<span id="cb21-10"><a href="#cb21-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># input_device_ptr = ...; output_device_ptr = ...; stream_handle = ...</span></span>
<span id="cb21-11"><a href="#cb21-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-12"><a href="#cb21-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_input_shape(<span class="st">"images"</span>, (<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>))</span>
<span id="cb21-13"><a href="#cb21-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_tensor_address(<span class="st">"images"</span>, <span class="bu">int</span>(input_device_ptr))</span>
<span id="cb21-14"><a href="#cb21-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.set_tensor_address(<span class="st">"logits"</span>, <span class="bu">int</span>(output_device_ptr))</span>
<span id="cb21-15"><a href="#cb21-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>context.execute_async_v3(stream_handle<span class="op">=</span>stream_handle)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Memory</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Ý nghĩa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Host</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">CPU RAM</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Device</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">GPU VRAM — kernels TRT chạy ở đây</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">H2D / D2H</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>CPU → GPU</code> trước infer; <code>GPU → CPU</code> nếu cần trả về host</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Sai: mỗi request <code>cudaMalloc → copy → execute → cudaFree</code>. Đúng: startup allocate pool; request borrow → copy/execute → return. Pipeline GPU end-to-end (<code>preprocess GPU → TRT → postprocess GPU</code>) tốt hơn copy qua CPU hai đầu khi throughput cao.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-26-contents" aria-controls="callout-26" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Nhiều optimization profiles (Python)
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-26" class="callout-26-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Realtime batch 1–4 vs batch job 8–64:</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb22"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb22-1"><a href="#cb22-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>profile0 <span class="op">=</span> builder.create_optimization_profile()</span>
<span id="cb22-2"><a href="#cb22-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>profile0.set_shape(<span class="st">"images"</span>, (<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>), (<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>), (<span class="dv">4</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>))</span>
<span id="cb22-3"><a href="#cb22-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>config.add_optimization_profile(profile0)</span>
<span id="cb22-4"><a href="#cb22-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb22-5"><a href="#cb22-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>profile1 <span class="op">=</span> builder.create_optimization_profile()</span>
<span id="cb22-6"><a href="#cb22-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>profile1.set_shape(<span class="st">"images"</span>, (<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>), (<span class="dv">32</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>), (<span class="dv">64</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>, <span class="dv">224</span>))</span>
<span id="cb22-7"><a href="#cb22-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>config.add_optimization_profile(profile1)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Runtime chọn <code>profile_index</code> theo shape request.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-accuracy" class="level2" data-number="4.11">
<h2 data-number="4.11" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-accuracy"><span class="header-section-number">4.11</span> Validate accuracy và Polygraphy</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>Chỉ nhìn latency sau khi build engine — thiếu gì?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Luôn so <code>accuracy_metric(TensorRT)</code> với reference (PyTorch FP32 / ORT FP32 / TRT FP32). Tolerance float <strong>không</strong> one-size-fits-all; với INT8 tensor có thể lệch nhiều nhưng <strong>task metric</strong> vẫn ổn. <strong>Polygraphy</strong> giúp inspect, so ORT vs TRT, debug precision nhanh hơn đọc raw log.</p>
</div>
</div>
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Task</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Gợi ý so sánh</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Classification</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">top-1/top-k, max/mean abs error, cosine logits</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Detection</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">mAP, box IoU, confidence distribution, NMS diff</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Segmentation</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">mIoU, pixel accuracy, boundary</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Embeddings</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">cosine similarity, recall@k, downstream metric</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb23"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb23-1"><a href="#cb23-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>np.testing.assert_allclose(trt_output, ort_output, rtol<span class="op">=</span><span class="fl">1e-3</span>, atol<span class="op">=</span><span class="fl">1e-3</span>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Có thể hợp lý cho FP16 một số model — không phải rule chung. Production: <strong>so task metric, không chỉ từng float</strong>.</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb24"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb24-1"><a href="#cb24-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">polygraphy</span> inspect model model.onnx</span>
<span id="cb24-2"><a href="#cb24-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-3"><a href="#cb24-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">polygraphy</span> run model.onnx <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb24-4"><a href="#cb24-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--onnxrt</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb24-5"><a href="#cb24-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--trt</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb24-6"><a href="#cb24-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--atol</span> 1e-3 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb24-7"><a href="#cb24-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--rtol</span> 1e-3</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Polygraphy còn: compare outputs, reduce failing model, inspect layer outputs, debug precision.</p>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-28-contents" aria-controls="callout-28" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Workflow chuẩn 10 bước (đủ lệnh)
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-28" class="callout-28-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>Export ONNX · 2. Validate ORT · 3. <code>polygraphy inspect</code> / Netron · 4. <code>trtexec</code> FP32 baseline · 5. Build FP16 · 6. <code>polygraphy run --onnxrt --trt</code> (+ metric validation set) · 7. Dynamic profile nếu cần · 8. <code>--dumpLayerInfo --dumpProfile</code> · 9. Deploy <code>.plan</code> (Triton / custom) · 10. Monitor p50/p95/p99, throughput, GPU util, memory, queue, error, accuracy drift.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="sec-debug-prod" class="level2" data-number="4.12">
<h2 data-number="4.12" class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sec-debug-prod"><span class="header-section-number">4.12</span> Debug, portability, Triton và best practices</h2>
<blockquote class="blockquote">
<p>ORT chạy được nhưng TRT fail; engine có mang máy khác được không; bắt đầu debug từ đâu?</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-important no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Quan trọng</span>Ý chính
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Hầu hết sự cố thuộc vài nhóm: unsupported op, profile/shape mismatch, build chậm, FP16 NaN, INT8 accuracy drop, app ≪ <code>trtexec</code>, engine không portable. <strong>ONNX valid ≠ TensorRT compatible</strong>. Engine artifact phải kèm metadata (TRT version, GPU arch, precision, profiles). Triton phục vụ <code>.plan</code> — TRT vẫn là compute backend.</p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="debug-playbook" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="debug-playbook">Debug playbook</h3>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 34%">
<col style="width: 65%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Triệu chứng</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Nguyên nhân / xử lý đầu</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>No importer registered for op: X</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Opset, simplify, rewrite, GraphSurgeon, plugin, split/ORT TRT EP fallback</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape outside profile / <code>set_input_shape</code> fail</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Shape trong <code>[min,max]</code>; đúng profile index &amp; input name; set shape trước execute</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Build rất chậm</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Timing cache; thu hẹp/bớt profiles; build offline CI; không build trên request path</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">FP16 NaN / accuracy ↓</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">So FP32 vs FP16; Polygraphy; giữ layer nhạy FP32; preprocessing</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">INT8 accuracy ↓</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Calibration đại diện + đúng preprocess; exclude layer; QAT; task metric</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">App chậm hơn <code>trtexec</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Xem tip <a href="#sec-trtexec" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.9</span></a> — thường app I/O/memory/sync</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Checklist profile mismatch:</p>
<pre class="text"><code>[ ] input name đúng chưa?
[ ] profile index đúng chưa?
[ ] shape nằm trong min/max chưa?
[ ] opt shape có phản ánh traffic thật chưa?
[ ] output shape đã infer sau khi set input shape chưa?</code></pre>
<p>Unsupported op — thứ tự: ONNX checker → ORT xác nhận model → Netron → <code>onnxsim</code> → đổi opset → rewrite → GraphSurgeon → plugin → hybrid pipeline.</p>
</section>
<section id="engine-portability" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="engine-portability">Engine portability</h3>
<p>Quản lý artifact theo: model version, TensorRT version, CUDA/cuDNN, GPU architecture, precision, profiles, build flags.</p>
<pre class="text"><code>resnet50_trt10.16_sm80_fp16_b1-32_224x224.plan
resnet50_trt10.16_sm90_fp16_b1-32_224x224.plan</code></pre>
<p>Metadata cạnh engine (ví dụ):</p>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb27"><pre class="sourceCode json code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode json"><span id="cb27-1"><a href="#cb27-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">{</span></span>
<span id="cb27-2"><a href="#cb27-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"model_name"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"resnet50"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-3"><a href="#cb27-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"model_version"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"2026-05-14"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-4"><a href="#cb27-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"tensorrt_version"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"10.16.1"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-5"><a href="#cb27-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"cuda_version"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"12.x"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-6"><a href="#cb27-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"gpu_arch"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"sm80"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-7"><a href="#cb27-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"precision"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"fp16"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-8"><a href="#cb27-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">"profiles"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="ot">[</span></span>
<span id="cb27-9"><a href="#cb27-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="fu">{</span></span>
<span id="cb27-10"><a href="#cb27-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      <span class="dt">"input"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="st">"images"</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-11"><a href="#cb27-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      <span class="dt">"min"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="ot">[</span><span class="dv">1</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">3</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">224</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">224</span><span class="ot">]</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-12"><a href="#cb27-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      <span class="dt">"opt"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="ot">[</span><span class="dv">8</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">3</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">224</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">224</span><span class="ot">]</span><span class="fu">,</span></span>
<span id="cb27-13"><a href="#cb27-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      <span class="dt">"max"</span><span class="fu">:</span> <span class="ot">[</span><span class="dv">32</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">3</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">224</span><span class="ot">,</span> <span class="dv">224</span><span class="ot">]</span></span>
<span id="cb27-14"><a href="#cb27-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="fu">}</span></span>
<span id="cb27-15"><a href="#cb27-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="ot">]</span></span>
<span id="cb27-16"><a href="#cb27-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">}</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</section>
<section id="tensorrt-trong-triton" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="tensorrt-trong-triton">TensorRT trong Triton</h3>
<pre class="text"><code>model_repository/
  resnet50/
    config.pbtxt
    1/
      model.plan</code></pre>
<p>Triton thêm: scheduling, dynamic batching, concurrent execution, versioning, metrics, health, ensemble. Engine vẫn là backend compute — chi tiết serving ở Lesson 6.</p>
</section>
<section id="best-practices-và-misconceptions" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="best-practices-và-misconceptions">Best practices và misconceptions</h3>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 35%">
<col style="width: 64%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Nhóm</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Thực hành</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Build</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Offline; lưu engine + metadata; timing cache; profile theo traffic; workspace đủ; validate sớm bằng <code>trtexec</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Precision</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">FP32 baseline → FP16 trước INT8; validate sau mỗi đổi; INT8: data đại diện hoặc QAT; ưu tiên Q/DQ</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Runtime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Deserialize một lần; reuse context/buffers; tránh alloc/copy thừa; stream + sync đúng</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Profiling</td>
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>trtexec</code> trước app; dump layer/profile; Nsight; tách compute vs H2D/D2H; p50/p95/p99</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 55%">
<col style="width: 45%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th style="text-align: left;">Hiểu nhầm</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Thực tế</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">TRT luôn nhanh hơn mọi runtime</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Phụ thuộc model, shape, precision, HW, transfer, app</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Bật FP16 = mọi layer FP16</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Có thể chọn theo layer</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">INT8 chỉ cần <code>--int8</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Cần scale / calibration / QDQ + validate</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">Dynamic càng rộng càng tốt</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Thường hại tactic quanh traffic thật</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td style="text-align: left;">Engine dùng mọi GPU</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Rebuild trên target (trừ compatibility mode phù hợp)</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;"><code>trtexec</code> nhanh → service nhanh</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Còn preprocess, queue, network, postprocess…</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-30-contents" aria-controls="callout-30" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Case: ORT CUDA chạy được nhưng <code>trtexec</code> fail
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-30" class="callout-30-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>ORT CUDA EP có thể chạy op bằng kernel riêng hoặc <strong>fallback CPU</strong>. TensorRT cần importer/layer/plugin — thiếu thì build fail. Cách nghĩ: <code>ONNX valid ≠ TensorRT compatible</code>. Xử lý: inspect node lỗi → support matrix → simplify → export lại → plugin → split graph.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="mini-lab" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="mini-lab">Mini-lab</h2>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-note no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Ghi chú</span>Thực hành — TensorRT với <code>trtexec</code> (và optional Python)
</div>
</div>
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<p>Giả sử <code>model.onnx</code>, input <code>images</code>, shape <code>[N,3,224,224]</code>. Ghi bảng median/p99 latency, throughput, GPU compute. Cần NVIDIA GPU + <code>trtexec</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="lab-1-build-benchmark-fp32fp16" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-1-build-benchmark-fp32fp16">Lab 1: Build &amp; benchmark FP32/FP16</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb29"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb29-1"><a href="#cb29-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp32.plan <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb29-2"><a href="#cb29-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb29-3"><a href="#cb29-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb29-4"><a href="#cb29-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb29-5"><a href="#cb29-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--fp16</span></span>
<span id="cb29-6"><a href="#cb29-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb29-7"><a href="#cb29-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb29-8"><a href="#cb29-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224 <span class="at">--noDataTransfers</span></span>
<span id="cb29-9"><a href="#cb29-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb29-10"><a href="#cb29-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb29-11"><a href="#cb29-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--noDataTransfers</span> <span class="at">--useCudaGraph</span> <span class="at">--useSpinWait</span> <span class="at">--duration</span><span class="op">=</span>60</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</section>
<section id="lab-2-dynamic-profile-minoptmax" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-2-dynamic-profile-minoptmax">Lab 2: Dynamic profile min/opt/max</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb30"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb30-1"><a href="#cb30-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--saveEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-2"><a href="#cb30-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--minShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-3"><a href="#cb30-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--optShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:8x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-4"><a href="#cb30-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--maxShapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:32x3x224x224 <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb30-5"><a href="#cb30-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--fp16</span></span>
<span id="cb30-6"><a href="#cb30-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb30-7"><a href="#cb30-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:1x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb30-8"><a href="#cb30-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:8x3x224x224</span>
<span id="cb30-9"><a href="#cb30-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--loadEngine</span><span class="op">=</span>model_dynamic_fp16.plan <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:32x3x224x224</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<p>Hỏi: batch nào latency thấp / throughput cao? Gần <code>optShapes</code> nhất? Batch 1 bất thường? Batch 32 memory pressure? Traffic thật có khớp <code>opt</code> không?</p>
</section>
<section id="lab-3-nhiều-optimization-profiles" class="level3 unnumbered">
<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-3-nhiều-optimization-profiles">Lab 3: Nhiều optimization profiles</h3>
<p>Realtime batch 1–4 vs batch 8–64 — dùng Python API như tip <a href="#sec-python-api" class="quarto-xref"><span>Mục 4.10</span></a>; runtime chọn profile theo shape.</p>
</section>

<h3 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="lab-4-dump-layer-info">Lab 4: Dump layer info</h3>
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode" id="cb31"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb31-1"><a href="#cb31-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">trtexec</span> <span class="at">--onnx</span><span class="op">=</span>model.onnx <span class="at">--shapes</span><span class="op">=</span>images:8x3x224x224 <span class="at">--fp16</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb31-2"><a href="#cb31-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--profilingVerbosity</span><span class="op">=</span>detailed <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb31-3"><a href="#cb31-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">--dumpLayerInfo</span> <span class="at">--dumpProfile</span> <span class="at">--separateProfileRun</span></span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<td style="text-align: right;"></td>
<td style="text-align: right;"></td>
<td style="text-align: right;"></td>
<td style="text-align: left;"></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td style="text-align: left;">TRT Q/DQ</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">8×3×224×224</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">INT8</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"></td>

<p>Câu hỏi: chọn engine nào cho production? Vì sao? Accuracy có chấp nhận được không?</p>
</div>

</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="checkpoint-questions" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="checkpoint-questions">Checkpoint questions</h2>
<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip no-icon callout-titled">
<div class="callout-header d-flex align-content-center collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target=".callout-33-contents" aria-controls="callout-33" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle callout">
<div class="callout-icon-container">
<i class="callout-icon no-icon"></i>
</div>
<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">
<span class="screen-reader-only">Mẹo</span>Tự kiểm
</div>
<div class="callout-btn-toggle d-inline-block border-0 py-1 ps-1 pe-0 float-end"><i class="callout-toggle"></i></div>
</div>
<div id="callout-33" class="callout-33-contents callout-collapse collapse">
<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">
<ol type="1">
<li>TensorRT engine / plan là gì? Compiled model đã chọn tactics, memory, precision.<br>
</li>
<li>Vì sao build chậm, runtime nhanh? Autotune tactics lúc build; runtime chỉ enqueue.<br>
</li>
<li>Builder vs Runtime? Compile vs load serialized engine.<br>
</li>
<li>ExecutionContext? State: profile, shape, addresses.<br>
</li>
<li>Tactic? Kernel/strategy cụ thể cho layer.<br>
</li>
<li>Workspace nhỏ ảnh hưởng gì? Loại tactic cần nhiều temp → có thể chậm hơn.<br>
</li>
<li>Timing cache? Reuse kết quả timing giữa các lần build.<br>
</li>
<li>ONNX dynamic vs TRT profile? <code>-1</code> chưa đủ; cần min/opt/max.<br>
</li>
<li><code>opt</code>? Shape ưu tiên tối ưu — khớp traffic thật.<br>
</li>
<li>Nhiều profiles khi nào? Cụm traffic khác nhau.<br>
</li>
<li>FP16 rủi ro? Overflow/NaN; không phải mọi layer FP16.<br>
</li>
<li>INT8 cần gì? Scale + calibration/QAT/QDQ + validate.<br>
</li>
<li>Rounding vs clamping error? Lưới int8 vs clip ngoài range.<br>
</li>
<li>Q/DQ? Explicit quantize/dequantize trong graph.<br>
</li>
<li>ORT ok, TRT fail? Fallback ORT vs thiếu importer TRT.<br>
</li>
<li>App chậm hơn trtexec? Copy/alloc/sync/preprocess.<br>
</li>
<li>Engine không portable? GPU arch + TRT version — metadata + rebuild.<br>
</li>
<li>Unsupported op — thứ tự xử lý? Checker → ORT → Netron → simplify → opset → rewrite → plugin.<br>
</li>
<li>INT8 accuracy ↓ — bắt đầu đâu? Calibration/preprocess → per-layer → QAT.<br>
</li>
<li>p99 cao — tách bottleneck thế nào? Preprocess / H2D / compute / D2H / post / queue.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="summary" class="level2 unnumbered">
<h2 class="unnumbered anchored" data-anchor-id="summary">Summary</h2>
<ol type="1">
<li>TensorRT = inference <strong>compiler</strong> + runtime NVIDIA — performance từ <strong>build-time specialization</strong>.<br>
</li>
<li>Engine = compiled model; Builder tạo; Runtime load; Context chạy trên stream.<br>
</li>
<li>Tactic + workspace + timing cache giải thích build lâu và engine khác nhau theo GPU/shape.<br>
</li>
<li>Profile <code>opt</code> phải phản ánh traffic; range quá rộng thường hại.<br>
</li>
<li>FP16 trước; INT8 cần quantization nghiêm túc (ví dụ số scale/clamp) + validate task metric.<br>
</li>
<li>Đo bằng <code>trtexec</code> nhưng quyết định production bằng E2E app + accuracy + metadata engine.</li>
</ol>
</section>
